news.title:
Finolex Cables appoints Sachin Naik as CFO and Key Managerial Person.
CEO Mahesh Viswanathan and CFO to manage disclosures to stock exchanges.

Finolex Cables' Dy. CEO and CFO to become CEO and CFO from June 1, 2026.
CEO has 43 years' experience; CFO brings 26 years in finance expertise.
Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹46.67 (up from ₹45.82 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹64.9b (up 22% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹7.14b (up 1.8% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 11% (down from 13% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 5.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 3.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 7% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 13% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Finolex Cables Limited Elevates Mahesh Viswanathan to Chief Executive Officer of the Company with Effect from 1 June 2026
news.body: Finolex Cables Limited at its board meeting held on 28 May 2026 approved Elevation of Mr. Mahesh Viswanathan currently designated as Dy. CEO & Chief Financial Officer as Chief Executive Officer of the Company with effect from 1 June 2026.
